verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a dedicated transactional API you call when a user needs a password reset or a purchase receipt. The same App API that sends transactional messages also triggers broadcasts, and the platform runs marketing automations and broadcasts alongside it, so one-to-one and marketing sends share one platform. Missing for 10: magic links are not explicitly named as a use case, the docs give little detail on the transactional API payload or templating, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
